segments.speaker: bree_tallow
segments.text: I set a bowl out for the old goblin woman. Silly. Habit. Somebody ought to mourn her.

segments.speaker: bree_tallow
segments.text: Stew's going up the hill by the potful. Don't look at me like that. Hungry's hungry.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
segments.text: Bree poured one for the goblin grandmother tonight. Nobody asked why. Nobody drank it.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
segments.text: We send stew up the hill now. Bree says hungry is hungry, whatever its ears look like.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_barmaid
segments.text: Folk keep coming in to shout about the mayor. Then they stay for the soup.

segments.speaker: bree_tallow
segments.text: You'll want feeding. Sit. I heard what happened on the bridge. I'm not asking, and you're not telling. Not tonight.

segments.speaker: bree_tallow
segments.text: Half the town says you've gone soft, and the other half is eating better for it. I know which half I'm in.
